modes_gate.title: Workbench: laser and CNC work
modes_gate.what: This page is for laser and CNC work: you place the job on the bed, set the origins and the height, manage the work zones, draw or import the cuts and follow the job as it runs. It does not apply to 3D printing.
modes_gate.why_unanswered: It is closed because nobody has said yet that this machine does laser or CNC work, and it is not in one of those modes now. Turn on what the machine does and the page opens.
modes_gate.why_off: It is closed because this machine is set up for 3D printing only (laser and CNC are off). If you add a laser or a spindle, turn it on below.
modes_gate.why_elsewhere: The machine is in {mode} mode now and this page serves {modes}. Switch the machine to one of those modes and the page opens by itself.
modes_gate.local_note: The machine profile of the service could not be read or written, so your answer is kept in this browser only. Other pages will not see it.
modes_gate.switches_title: What does this machine do besides printing?
modes_gate.row_laser_what: What it is: a laser head that cuts or engraves material.
modes_gate.row_laser_why: What it is for: it turns on the laser tools of this page (bed map, power per layer, focus height).
modes_gate.row_laser_missing: If it is off: this page stays closed for laser work.
modes_gate.row_laser_help: How: turn it on only if the machine has a laser wired and set up in config.g.
modes_gate.row_cnc_what: What it is: a spindle that mills or carves material.
modes_gate.row_cnc_why: What it is for: it turns on the CNC tools of this page (zones, heights, toolpaths).
modes_gate.row_cnc_missing: If it is off: this page stays closed for CNC work.
modes_gate.row_cnc_help: How: turn it on only if the machine has a spindle defined in config.g.
modes_gate.saved_local: Saved in this browser (the service did not accept it).
modes_gate.miss_answer: Missing: say that this machine does laser or CNC work (Laser or CNC turned on).
modes_gate.miss_switch: Missing: the machine is in {mode} mode and it has to be in {modes}.
modes_gate.step_answer_what: What it is: the answer to which modes this machine uses. It is saved once for the whole machine.
modes_gate.step_answer_why: What it is for: this page and the start-up cards only show what applies to your machine.
modes_gate.step_answer_missing: If it is missing: the page stays closed.
modes_gate.step_answer_help: How: tick what the machine has and press the button. Nothing is moved and no file is created.
modes_gate.step_switch: Switch the machine to the mode
modes_gate.step_switch_what: What it is: the machine works in one mode at a time (printing, laser or CNC).
modes_gate.step_switch_why: What it is for: the page follows the mode the machine is in now.
modes_gate.step_switch_missing: If it is missing: the page waits, closed, until the machine is in that mode.
modes_gate.step_switch_help: How: with the machine idle, switch it with the mode buttons of the control bar or run the macro of the mode (macros/mode/selectlaser.g or selectcnc.g). Then press the button.
modes_gate.pick_one: Tick Laser or CNC, or press "I do not use laser or CNC".
modes_gate.not_using: I do not use laser or CNC
modes_gate.still_missing: It is still not in the right mode.
